milestone: SeLinOS VFS M0 bounded volatile state transaction

contract.object: One server-owned volatile word at the fixed packed pathname /selinos-state and fixed descriptor 5.
contract.open: Only the declared file selector or exact 14-byte packed pathname opens the descriptor.
contract.read: Read requires the open descriptor and offset zero, returning exactly one word.
contract.write: Write requires exactly three IPC words: opcode, fixed descriptor and complete replacement word. The server commits the replacement only after validation.
contract.close: Close clears the server-local open state; later write attempts are rejected.
contract.backing: The word is initialized at server boot and is deliberately volatile; no device, DMA frame, block request or persistence abstraction is used.

required_markers: SeLinOS vfs M0: one fixed volatile state record is server-owned and non-persistent.
SeLinOS VFS M0 probe: bounded volatile write/read/close lifecycle passed.
SeLinOS ROMFS probe: CPIO pathname multi-file lookup passed.
forbidden_markers: SeLinOS VFS M0 probe: volatile state open failed.
SeLinOS VFS M0 probe: malformed volatile write was accepted.
SeLinOS VFS M0 probe: malformed write changed volatile state.
SeLinOS VFS M0 probe: volatile write failed.
SeLinOS VFS M0 probe: volatile read-after-write failed.
SeLinOS VFS M0 probe: closed volatile FD accepted write.

not_claimed: persistent storage, crash recovery, journaling, flush or durability
block I/O, virtqueue, IRQ, DMA or IOMMU containment
arbitrary paths, directories, symlinks, metadata, permissions or multi-client descriptor tables
streaming, partial, append or mmap writes
POSIX filesystem compatibility, package extraction, dpkg or apt
